name: Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim
short_description: A lifestyle select-service high-rise in Central Jakarta's Wahid Hasyim corridor, walkable to Sarinah and Plaza Indonesia, with the Nook restaurant, WXYZ bar, a covered pool and a fitness center.
ai_summary: Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim is Aloft's lifestyle select-service tower in Central Jakarta's Menteng/Wahid Hasyim area, and reportedly the brand's first property in Indonesia. It is one of three Jakarta Alofts, and should not be confused with Aloft Jakarta TB Simatupang in South Jakarta or the Aloft near Kebon Jeruk in the west; this is the central, most walkable of the trio, minutes on foot from Sarinah and Plaza Indonesia. TripAdvisor ranks it around #79 of Jakarta hotels at roughly 4 of 5, and independent reviewers (Milesopedia 8/10, SuiteSmile, Ludyah Annisah) consistently praise a strategic location, warm attentive service, and a well-priced breakfast at Nook mixing local, Asian and Western dishes. Rooms follow the modern industrial Aloft template with good beds, fast free WiFi and strong showers, and high floors deliver skyline and Monas views. Common gripes: the covered swimming pool feels small, dim and enclosed by privacy railings, the gym is compact (though well-equipped), and some finishes and carpets read slightly dated. Marriott elite members single out generous perks including all-day coffee/tea sent to the room. Net: strong value and a genuinely central base for exploring Jakarta, best for short lifestyle-minded stays rather than resort-style leisure.

faqs.question: How far is Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim from Soekarno-Hatta Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: It is roughly 25 km from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, about a 40-45 minute drive depending on traffic.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the other Aloft hotels in Jakarta?
faqs.answer: No. This is the Central Jakarta property on Jl. K.H. Wahid Hasyim in the Menteng area, distinct from Aloft Jakarta TB Simatupang in South Jakarta and the Aloft near Kebon Jeruk in West Jakarta.

faqs.question: What dining and facilities are available?
faqs.answer: The hotel has Nook restaurant, the WXYZ bar, a 24-hour Re:Fuel pantry, a covered outdoor pool and a fitness center. Reviewers rate breakfast and service highly but note the pool is small.

reviews.title: Review: Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim | Marriott Bonvoy
reviews.author: Jean-Maximilien Voisine
reviews.summary: Rated 8/10. Central near Grand Indonesia and Monas; standard Aloft rooms with towel art and spacious shower. Pool small and dim; gym well-equipped. Dining: Nook, WXYZ bar, 24h Re:Fuel. Attentive staff; good for budget stays.

reviews.title: Review: Aloft Jakarta Wahid Hasyim (Standard Room)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: 28 sqm standard room with strong furnishing and bathroom. Central, ~10 min to Grand Indonesia. Nook breakfast rated 9/10. Praised early check-in and all-day coffee/tea to room for elites; covered pool, gym, WXYZ bar.

reviews.title: Aloft Hotel Wahid Hasyim Jakarta Review: Ini Lho Rasanya Menginap Saat Pandemi!
reviews.author: Ludyah Annisah
reviews.summary: Strategic central location, walkable to Sarinah. Minimalist-industrial King room on the 23rd floor with skyline and Monas views, toiletries and kettle. Nook served breakfast during the pandemic. Pool, gym, free bicycles and premium WiFi.
